name: Kochi Heritage Project
summary: The Kochi Heritage Project is a small-group heritage walk and event organiser in Kochi. Its walks cover Fort Kochi and Mattancherry, tracing the city's story as an Indian Ocean port.
highlights: Fort Cochin Heritage Tour, a guided walk of roughly 2-3 hours
Mattancherry and Jew Town heritage walks
Runs heritage events such as the Cochin Heritage Carnival
